standard: IEEE P1952, Standard for Resilient Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) User Equipment (draft)
status: A draft standard under development. Topics are mapped by subject only, with no clause numbers, until the standard is published; the mapping will be revised then.
wording: Each topic lists the evidence this scorecard carries for it. The evidence is test evidence for the cases run; it is not a statement that the equipment meets the draft or any published standard.

topics.summary: Whether and how fast the equipment, or a monitor on its output, recognises that a threat is present.
Whether the equipment gives wrong position or time without warning while a threat is present.
How much of the threat period the equipment keeps giving a solution, and how far it degrades.
Whether and how fast the equipment returns to correct output after the threat ends.
The level the campaign's evidence supports under the stated bars, case by case.
What was run, on which inputs, under which bars, by which method version.
